description: GET /v1/webhooks/:id/deliveries/:deliveryId - one delivery attempt with its retained payload (the exact body that was signed and sent) and the endpoint's response; the selected network mode must match. Specify mode when both or neither key modes are cached. Uses the cached sk_* key of that mode, else a fresh JWT (GET /v1/merchants/me/webhooks/:id/deliveries/:deliveryId).
name: webhooks_delivery
title: Inspect webhook delivery
